taxonomies_consolidated.name: container size
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect relating to the dimensions and capacity of containers or packaging vessels, e.g. small containers, mini size containers, 1 ounce containers

taxonomies_consolidated.name: color variety and vibrancy
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect relating to the range, intensity, and visual appeal of colors available in art supplies, e.g. variety of colors, vibrant colors, bright and bold colors, very pigmented colors

taxonomies_consolidated.name: color application texture
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect relating to the tactile quality and smoothness of color application from art supplies, e.g. smooth texture when coloring, even color distribution

taxonomies_consolidated.name: packaging design quality
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect relating to the structural integrity and aesthetic appeal of product packaging, e.g. sturdy box, cute packaging, flip-top box design

taxonomies_consolidated.name: packaging damage condition
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect relating to compromised or defective packaging integrity upon receipt, e.g. damaged boxes, open packaging, torn containers

taxonomies_consolidated.name: material safety composition
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect relating to the chemical composition and safety properties of art supply materials, e.g. non-toxic materials, wheat-free composition, allergen-free ingredients

taxonomies_consolidated.name: tip writing performance
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect relating to the smoothness and consistency of writing or drawing tip performance, e.g. smooth writing, even ink flow, consistent line quality

taxonomies_consolidated.name: tip fragility and breakage
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect relating to the tendency of tips to break or become damaged during use, e.g. tips breaking easily, fragile points, brittle tips

taxonomies_consolidated.name: tip durability and strength
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect relating to the structural integrity and resistance of tips to wear and damage, e.g. strong tips, durable points, break-resistant tips

taxonomies_consolidated.name: tip sharpness degradation
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect relating to the loss of tip sharpness and precision over time or with use, e.g. tips getting dull quickly, losing sharpness, becoming blunt

taxonomies_consolidated.name: tip initial sharpness
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect relating to the sharpness and precision of tips when the product is new or unused, e.g. not sharp when new, dull out of package, blunt initial tips
original_names: tips_not sharp at tips when new

taxonomies_consolidated.name: pencil structural deformity
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect relating to shape distortions and structural irregularities in pencil form, e.g. warped pencils, curved pencils, bent structure

taxonomies_consolidated.name: pencil grip comfort
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect relating to the ergonomic comfort and ease of holding pencils during use, e.g. comfortable to hold, ergonomic design, pleasant grip feel

taxonomies_consolidated.name: pencil size dimensions
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect relating to the overall dimensions and proportions of pencils, e.g. nice size pencil, appropriate length, good thickness
